_comment: LoadstoneMC Pterodactyl egg. Import it from Nests -> Import Egg. The install script downloads a prebuilt release binary from GitHub; there is no Java or build step.
name: LoadstoneMC
author: IndoGeek@github
description: A Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.11 (protocol 774) server written from scratch in Rust. Runs a native binary; no Java runtime is required.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -e

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

ARCH="$(uname -m)"
case "$ARCH" in
  x86_64 | amd64) TARGET="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;;
  aarch64 | arm64) TARGET="aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;;
  *)
    echo "Unsupported CPU architecture: $ARCH"
    exit 1
    ;;
  esac

URL="{{DOWNLOAD_URL}}"
if [ -z "$URL" ] || [ "$URL" = "latest" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/IndoGeek/LoadstoneMC/releases/latest/download/loadstone-${TARGET}.tar.gz"
fi

echo "Downloading LoadstoneMC from $URL"
curl -fsSL "$URL" -o /tmp/loadstone.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/loadstone.tar.gz -C /mnt/server --strip-components=1
rm -f /tmp/loadstone.tar.gz
chmod +x /mnt/server/loadstone

[ -d /mnt/server/world ] || mkdir -p /mnt/server/world

echo "LoadstoneMC installed."

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Server list message of the day.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Player count shown in the server list.

variables.name: Online mode
variables.description: true encrypts connections and verifies accounts with Mojang; false allows offline clients.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: Seconds between automatic saves of dirty chunks (0 disables autosave).

variables.name: Extra arguments
variables.description: Any additional server flags, for example: --seed 1234 --world world2

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Override the release archive to install. Leave empty to use the latest GitHub release for this machine's architecture.
